deepReviews.name: bleachbit/bleachbit
sourceEvidence: cleaner definitions and test workflow in shallow clone
findings: Preview is a strong safety boundary before deletion.
Cleaner definitions are data-driven and auditable.
Tests and Windows build workflow are treated as first-class project artifacts.
adopted: Keep scan-before-clean and show exact paths, sizes and reasons.
Keep fixed service-side cleaner IDs and revalidate age/path at execution.
rejected: No GPL source reuse; no second cleaner engine dependency.

deepReviews.name: Sophia-Community/SophiApp
findings: Settings are grouped by user goal rather than implementation layer.
Reversible and localized actions are visible in the product surface.
Release and CI signals are prominent in the project workflow.
adopted: Keep settings grouped by outcome and show capability limits.
Use explicit status text for unsupported or permission-limited checks.
rejected: Do not add broad privacy or registry tweak actions without a reversible operation model.

deepReviews.name: sPROFFEs/ClamAV-GUI
deepReviews.license: CC-BY-NC-4.0 for the application; ClamAV remains GPLv2
findings: The workflow makes scan, quarantine, definition update, watcher and scheduled scan states explicit.
The app uses cancellation and diagnostics as part of the primary UX.
Cross-platform engine boundaries are separated into platform projects.
adopted: Keep explicit scan states and cancellation messages.
Keep engine/platform boundaries visible in the current layered architecture.
rejected: Do not replace Microsoft Defender as the product's authoritative Windows engine.
Do not copy assets or code under a non-compatible license.

deepReviews.name: ahmetcaglayan/Hexnest
findings: Measured cleanup and live system/network views are presented together.
Windows-only sources are removed from the portable target instead of being left as empty pages.
Portable self-contained delivery reduces first-run dependency failures.
adopted: Preserve honest unavailable states in platform queries.
Keep build and publish outputs self-contained where already supported.
rejected: Driver update/installation is outside this product's security scope.

deepReviews.name: chrisriv10/Soterios
findings: A first-run wizard makes privacy, notifications and protection choices explicit.
Privacy mode defines exactly which external lookups are disabled.
Release artifacts include checksums and dependency metadata, while the README discloses unsigned installers.
adopted: Remove unimplemented hash reputation controls from Settings.
Keep network behavior opt-in and explain local versus external processing.
Keep update integrity checks and disclose signing gaps.
rejected: No Electron or Node runtime migration for the existing WPF application.

limitations: GitHub API metadata requests reached anonymous rate limits during the run; candidate URLs and source clones are recorded, while volatile star counts were intentionally omitted.
Gitee and GitLab did not yield a stronger directly comparable Windows desktop reference within the available search window; no claim of exhaustive ecosystem coverage is made.
